name: CS50x certificate
free_option: Free CS50 certificate (paid edX verified certificate optional)

name: Tiny Tapeout: your design on a real chip
free_option: Design and harden free in GitHub Actions; paying is only for fabrication. University/subsidised options may exist
price_status: 2025 projection: ~EUR 70 per tile, ~EUR 300 devkit; use the official calculator
notes: A taped-out tile with a public GDS is the strongest proof a tier-3 fresher can show. Shuttles SKY26d and GF26c listed as open on 2026-10-23.

name: IEEE SSCS PICO Open-Source Chipathon
free_option: Free; open to anyone; selected designs are fabricated
notes: IEEE-backed contest with silicon and a write-up. 2026 sign-up closed 1 May 2026; plan for the 2027 call (watch from Feb 2027).

name: Hack@DAC hardware security CTF result
free_option: Free team entry
notes: Competition rank, not a certificate; student teams (incl. IIT Kharagpur) have placed. Strong hardware-security signal.

name: Maven Silicon job-oriented VLSI programme (e.g. with iHUB IIT Roorkee)

name: ChipEdge VLSI training
